allocation.forward_command: common propeller percentage; left = right = PC surge
allocation.steering: native yaw PID controls static tail attack angle
allocation.zero_forward: no tail oscillation or common propeller thrust; tail angle remains controlled

propulsion.speed_measurement: median one-second metric displacement in the final 2 seconds of camera samples during drive
propulsion.quality: late-drive reference only; raw traces still accelerate, so these are not verified steady-state speeds
propulsion.below_measured_range: estimate along the line from zero to the first measured point; keep visual PID feedback
propulsion.above_measured_range: hold feedforward at the highest measured command; keep visual PID feedback
limitations: The default 0.10 m/s target is below the measured propulsion range.
The 40 percent run has no reliable late-drive speed and is excluded.
Tail-angle steering adds drag; the straight-run map is feedforward only.
No measured braking or turn-radius envelope is enabled for the new allocation.

curve_envelope.reason: Existing turn runs use tail oscillation and/or propeller differential; no matched left/right radius and zero-forward coast data cover the new allocation.
